title: KCSAN: data-race in process_srcu / synchronize_srcu
two_threads_summary: srcu_gp_end() (called from process_srcu workqueue) writes ->srcu_last_gp_end; srcu_might_be_idle() called from synchronize_srcu (task) reads it. Fix adds WRITE_ONCE/READ_ONCE.
audit_notes: Real cross-context race fixed with paired *_ONCE.
fix_commit_message:
844a378de3372c923909681706d62336d702531e
srcu: Apply *_ONCE() to ->srcu_last_gp_end

The ->srcu_last_gp_end field is accessed from any CPU at any time
by synchronize_srcu(), so non-initialization references need to use
READ_ONCE() and WRITE_ONCE().  This commit therefore makes that change.
